observations.observation: Salon uses a serif display while CRM uses a sans display; both mobile headings fit the component width.
observations.reason: Type roles vary with the proposed identity while preserving legibility.

observations.observation: All 26 knowledge entries create an overly long default exploration list.
observations.reason: The list pushes review and results far below the builder on mobile.
observations.correction: Show eight entries initially and provide explicit expansion and search.

observations.observation: The technology component uses a different palette/material from the salon study.
observations.reason: These are distinguishable starting hypotheses; this is not proof of an original full website.

observations.observation: The selected-tab light stays in the existing row; neighboring typography and content align as before.
observations.reason: The decoration does not create a competing layout system.

observations.observation: CRM uses a restrained blue operational palette and compact spacing instead of salon editorial type.
observations.reason: The profile supports the operational task; actual brand fit still needs customer content.

observations.reviewer: Codex visual inspection + browser.json interaction record
observations.observation: Reduced-motion capture shows a stationary visible object; native scroll and preference changes were exercised separately.
observations.reason: Static image alone is not motion evidence; the linked tests establish response and reversal.

observations.observation: Quick-edit output explicitly preserves the incumbent system and offers real file/brief exports.
observations.reason: The mode no longer instructs a new brand identity for a bounded change.

observations.observation: Long generated text wraps inside the narrow column; export controls remain usable.
observations.reason: The interface was rendered and exercised at 320px rather than inferred from a desktop screenshot.

observations.observation: Four link targets per snapshot were below the audit size threshold.
observations.reason: Touch use benefits from a deliberate target height; this is not a full accessibility certification.
observations.correction: Give the local Studio header/footer/explorer links 44px minimum heights and re-run identical snapshots.

observations.observation: Actual keyboard activation, state change and native contact destination remain working in the scoped fixture.
observations.reason: The visual change preserves the existing task paths.

refinement: The two recorded issues were corrected and re-captured in engine/audit/audit.json. Images were inspected as file artifacts; Remote Desktop Commander review was interrupted.
